blocks.text: SM Development Corporation (SMDC) has brought its homebuyer outreach with Pag-IBIG Fund to Visayas, giving families in Iloilo and Bacolod an opportunity to explore properties and seek guidance on housing finance. The October 16–18 Home Ownership Weekend follows the partners’ September 8 agreement in Metro Manila. It takes the collaboration into regional communities, where prospective buyers can visit SMDC developments, discuss their housing needs and learn how to prepare for a home purchase. The regional effort was marked on October 16 by a walkthrough at Glade Residences in Jaro, Iloilo, followed by a symbolic handover ceremony at Molo Mansion. SMDC also […]...
